name: Tijuana

queries.query: Tijuana Catastro Municipal cartografía mapa predios polígonos parcela GIS oficial
queries.scope: Find official Tijuana municipal cadastral records and any open parcel map or vector endpoint.
queries.result: The Ayuntamiento’s Dirección de Catastro Municipal lists cartography services for certified and simple plan copies, boundary certifications and parcel polygons. The services require a request and payment receipt, and some require the parcel plan or field-book documents. IMPLAN describes the public Gemelo Digital as a geospatial viewer and the Atlas as risk-themed layers; neither inspected public page exposes parcel vector data.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Spanish-language search; first-party municipal Catastro, IMPLAN portal, Atlas app and read-only shell inspection.

queries.query: Tijuana municipal cadastral parcel map public GIS Catastro city lot polygons
queries.scope: Cross-check public parcel viewer availability and whether the advertised GIS relates to cadastral rather than zoning/risk.
queries.result: English-language official results point to the same local municipal Catastro and IMPLAN GIS. The municipal cartography catalog provides plan-copy and polygon-certification workflows, while the public planning GIS page describes thematic geographic layers and the risk atlas. No anonymous full parcel geometry was verified.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search and public official page review; no account or parcel request.

portals.name: Dirección de Catastro Municipal (DCM)
portals.operator: H. Ayuntamiento de Tijuana, Secretaría de Desarrollo Urbano y Ecología
portals.observation: Official municipal cadastre page describes the city cadastral office and its cartographic records.

portals.name: Departamento de Cartografía services
portals.operator: Dirección de Catastro Municipal, Ayuntamiento de Tijuana
portals.observation: Official service list offers certified/simple plan copies and parcel boundary certifications; each requires a service request and payment receipt. It does not expose a public parcel download/API.

portals.name: Carta Urbana del Gemelo Digital Tijuana
portals.operator: Instituto Metropolitano de Planeación de Tijuana (IMPLAN)
portals.observation: Official page describes an urban GIS viewer for geographic layers in 2D/2.5D/3D. Its linked map route redirected to the IMPLAN home page during inspection; no parcel layer or geometry response was confirmed.

portals.name: Atlas Municipal de Riesgos de Tijuana
portals.observation: Public application identifies risk-map layers, drawing and export tools; it is a hazard atlas, not a public cadastral parcel service.

requests.observation: Lists cartography services and requirements: requests and payment receipts; certified parcel polygons require supplied plan and field-book data.
Official IMPLAN geospatial portal shell includes public registration/login controls. No anonymous parcel layer query was available in the inspected pages.
Public GIS application is the 2024 municipal risk atlas; no parcel polygon service was identified.
Public page describes Carta Urbana GIS and links an embedded map. Its linked route redirected to the IMPLAN home page, so no working public parcel map was verified.

freshResearch.executionMethod: Official Spanish and English search, direct first-party HTML/app inspection; no credentials, owner records or certified parcel copy requests.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: No public parcel-vector request was available in the inspected municipal applications. Official public cartography services require an application and payment; no parcel geometry was fetched.

source.name: Dirección de Catastro Municipal cartography services
source.serviceType: Municipal cadastral records and paid/request-based plan and polygon-certification services; public vector format not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Tijuana municipal Catastro maintains cartographic plans and parcel-boundary certification services for the municipality.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The public IMPLAN/Gemelo Digital content inspected covers planning and risk themes; public parcel-level geometry is not exposed. Cartography documents are requested from the municipal Catastro office.

registryBasis: First-party Ayuntamiento pages identify the Dirección de Catastro Municipal and its cartography department, including parcel polygon certifications and map-copy services.
technicalBlocker: Parcel plans and boundary certifications are provided through an application/payment workflow; the inspected public GIS pages expose planning/risk layers rather than cadastral vectors.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate anonymous municipal cadastral viewer exists outside the inspected IMPLAN pages; the advertised Carta Urbana embedded map route did not resolve to a live viewer.
nextStep: Keep runtime disabled. If the city exposes a public parcel layer later, verify the exact WUP vicinity and full polygon response before adapter work.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
